summary: ZKH Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the extension of its existing share repurchase program. The board authorized an extension for an additional 12 months through June 13, 2027, maintaining the $50 million authorization limit. As of the press date, the company had repurchased approximately 2.1 million ADSs. Repurchases may occur on the open market, in privately negotiated transactions, or block trades, funded from existing cash. No advisor or premium is noted. This is a routine capital return program extension, not a special situation; however, it is classified as 'Capital Returns' because the filing itself is the repurchase program update. Watch for execution pace versus market price.
